rule.text: Declared before any run: per listed stratum, the first 3 valid_feasible benchmark samples in declared seed order (feasibility classes only, never kinematic outcomes): 8 ID strata (24 episodes) and A_OOD (3: pose/size OOD, where Native-specific reach, tracking and grasp effects concentrate). A stratum with fewer than 3 valid_feasible samples runs what it has and records the shortfall; every unselected sample keeps its reason.

not_selected_strata.status: NOT_RUN in Native by declared budget (decided before the freeze)
not_selected_strata.reason: OOD has no target; the kinematic run measures every OOD dimension on all 10 samples per stratum, while 3 Native samples (one per dimension at best) cannot locate a boundary; BF is a known-failure-dominated boundary study; Native cost is 6-17 min per episode on the single Native GPU, shared with the 14 Phase 7 demo runs.
